# Architecture Recommendation

**Deploy a self-contained, containerized microservices architecture using Kubernetes (or Docker Compose for simpler deployments) with all models, data, and dependencies bundled locally.** Implement an internal service mesh for inter-service communication, local caching (leveraging the observed 0.91 cache hit ratio), and embedded inference engines rather than external APIs. This approach satisfies the offline-first constraint [ctx_0001], aligns with the team's deployment tool experience [ctx_0002], remains maintainable [ctx_0004], and the current system health metrics [ctx_0006–ctx_0013] demonstrate this architecture can operate stably at modest resource utilization.
